# Server tick rate benchmark thresholds
# Format: key <value_ms>
# Updated by: tests/server_tick_bench --update-thresholds
# Do NOT edit manually: run the benchmark with --update-thresholds
# to regenerate after a refactoring that changes the tick time.
# (values = measured x 1.5, rounded up to 0.1 ms)

# Average tick time must stay under half the 16.7 ms frame budget of
# the 60 Hz server loop, leaving headroom for sign_galaxy_data(),
# send_pending_updates() and the epoll event loop.
threshold_ms 8.0
# 99th percentile must stay under three quarters of the frame budget
# (a single slow tick is tolerated; a tail of slow ticks is not).
p99_ms 12.0
